verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents a free Moderation API explicitly for reducing unsafe content, a dedicated safety-best-practices guide, structured outputs/function calling to constrain and gate model actions before execution, and an evals framework to test outputs against criteria — together these are concrete guardrail primitives and documented patterns. missing for 10: no independent/community hands-on validation of the moderation endpoint's real-world efficacy, and no worked example specifically showing a 'gate output before acting' pipeline end-to-end.
